notes.title: Community Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made Mae's character invulnerable.
[*] The experience required to reach the first levels has been rebalanced (easy adjustment).
[*] Brutus character has been enhanced for a more balanced gameplay.
[*] The font of the in-game text in the inventory has been changed to improve readability and visual comfort.
[*] The sound of Mei's character's katana has become quieter for a more balanced sound experience.
[*] Improved English localization for a more harmonious immersion in the game world.
[*] Ghost enemies are now more visible to increase game honesty and improve interaction with the game environment.
[*] Several minor bug fixes have been made to improve the stability of the gameplay.
[*] Thank you for your support and feedback! Stay tuned and enjoy the game!
[/list]
